detail.longDescription:
When I started moving my stuff to self-hosted open source, the one thing I couldn't find was a decent period tracker for my wife. So I started writing one.

She never got to use it. She got pregnant before it was ready.

Turns out a lot of other people wanted it anyway. Ovumcy is at v2.1.0 now.

The thing people ask for most is import from other apps. Before I build it: what do you track in today?

#SelfHosted #Privacy #FOSS

[ ] Flo
[ ] Clue
[ ] Drip or another FOSS app
[ ] Paper, or nothing yet
